outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative super-resolution image reconstructions (localizations, density maps, cluster segmentation), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows representative super-resolution image reconstructions for PacL2-mEos, not a plot of averaged data.
Scatter plot of number of clusters per cell shows the mean ± SEM as a bar/line overlaid on individual gray dots representing each cell, as stated in the caption.
Scatter plot of cluster sizes displays the mean ± SEM together with individual gray dots for each cluster, consistent with the caption description.
Scatter plot of percentage of molecules in clusters shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots per cell.
Panel F shows representative sptPALM image reconstructions and trajectory overlays, not an averaged-data plot.

The top histogram shows the distribution of diffusion coefficients (counts per bin, i.e., raw pooled data, not an average), and the bottom panel plots individual trajectory MSD curves rather than a single averaged value, so no additional individual-point overlay is required.
Panel H shows trajectory maps, a kymograph, and example single-molecule trajectories, not a plot summarizing data as an average.
